page.overview:
Who is Pingtsi?

Pingtsi possesses a corpse with dark hair with a blue hue and has a Futakuchi-onna-like ponytail along with eye-length bangs and slightly longer side bangs. Given the same coloration of the ponytail and the rest of the hair, it is unknown if the ponytail was originally a part of the corpse or a part of the devil that took the form of one. All the hairbands she wears have been shown as red. She wears a long-sleeved, knee-length black dress with white cuffs and a dress collar. She wears plain black shoes and black leggings. Her eyes on her ponytail seem to be purple, while the eyes on her face may either be red or purple. She is considerably shorter than the rest of Quanxi’s fiends.

Pingtsi is a very cheerful, talkative girl who likes to share useless facts in order to impress or entertain Quanxi.

Pingtsi is shown as one of Quanxi's girlfriends, alongside Cosmo, Long, and Tsugihagi. She's loyal to Quanxi and is shown following her around. After arriving in Japan, Pingtsi asks Quanxi for them to go to a sushi restaurant. In the restaurant she demonstrates her knowledge of fish, much to Quanxi's dismay.

Later, Quanxi is assisted by her and the others as she makes her way to the mall, all the while slaughtering every doll and Devil Hunter in sight, which makes Pingtsi make a snarky comment, saying that corpses are talking. Pingtsi is assisting Quanxi and her fellow fiends finish off the remaining dolls outside the mall, while saying they should catch up to Quanxi quickly.
